context: The user requested that the XRBitcoinCash main trading page visually match the accepted XRBC Liquidity Pool exchange/workbench layout. The shared opt-in exchange shell was already the canonical design system, so the homepage was migrated into that shell rather than building another independent CSS system.

shared_design_system.rule: Homepage-specific styles are scoped so the Liquidity Pool and other unreviewed pages are not globally restyled.

desktop_layout: Fixed left navigation rail matching the Liquidity Pool visual language.
Existing Get XRBC in Xaman CTA retained as a compact sidebar action.
Theme control retained in the sidebar.
Former large hero becomes a compact workbench heading.
Trading terminal uses neutral black/charcoal surfaces, thin borders and compact spacing.
Chart/market workspace is the primary surface.
Order panel is a sticky right-side action rail.
Market stats, pair selection, chart navigation, market identity and open orders use dense neutral card language.
responsive_layout: At <=900px the fixed rail becomes compact top navigation.
Get XRBC and theme controls become compact utilities.
Order rail and chart stack into one column.
Order rail moves before the chart for the primary action path.

behavior_preservation.fingerprint_method: FNV-1a comparison of all executable inline script blocks before/after

manual_checks: Desktop fixed left rail matches Liquidity Pool.
Sidebar Get XRBC and theme controls remain usable.
Compact heading/terminal replace the oversized top-header/hero feel.
Chart/market workspace is left and sticky order rail is right.
Connect/Reconnect and a small Xaman review still work.
Mobile/tablet top navigation and stacked order/chart layout render cleanly.
